summary: 26 features and 6 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • scheduled-messages: anchor sends to Agent CLI resets (695ec17)
  • sessions: support repository-scoped target project access (48e0417)
  • scope: add layered cross-project scope suggestions (37190f0)
  • sessions: expose scheduled message summaries (d07a3a6)
  • token-monitor: add quota progress mode setting (3b9ab54)
  • auto-compose-commit: render only the selected commit strategy (5738138)
  • scope: add AI-assisted session scope suggestions (1727434)
  • token-monitor: add independent usage and quota sources (b0f460e)

HagiCode-org/web

  • i18n: translate cross-project scopes and reset scheduling (ed07c5f)
  • scheduled-send: schedule messages after session resets (16a5e96)
  • scope-selection: add cross-project repository scopes (90a87cd)
  • i18n: translate scheduled markers and quota progress (2e96183)
  • mobile-remote-input: animate command transmission outcomes (140e9e0)
  • sessions: surface scheduled messages across session views (2ef3cf0)
  • token-monitor: let users choose quota bar progress mode (f68f2e9)
  • image-lightbox: pan oversized images by dragging (f2ad056)
  • preset-task: align HagiTask creation with proposal drawer (fe3cdfc)
  • theme: fit generated palettes to contrast and surface rules (a619d86)
  • i18n: localize Smart Scope across supported locales (0e98279)
  • scope-selection: add Smart Scope to create drawers (26cfbe9)
  • wizard: emphasize demo setup for untouched projects (6bfc685)
  • mobile: verify scanned servers before saving (3375839)
  • startup: retry backend bootstrap and explain failures (fe5a7f3)
  • proposal: restore recent project and repository setups (c815b58)
  • token-monitor: select usage and quota sources independently (2f4d48e)
  • session-list: open Saga groups in the main session panel (ff541b0)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • claude-helper: extend provider startup timeout (963ff66)

HagiCode-org/web

  • config-panel: contain settings scrolling within the panel (f7efadd)
  • kanban-matrix: keep the selected cell bound in the side panel (8e8e109)
  • theme: use readable colors for remaining UI states (46517f3)
  • project-list: label project avatar buttons (5f578b9)
  • statusbar: expose full text for clipped announcements (be368fb)
